description: Memory-brain navigation: read-only graph/search/provenance/conflict tools over memory.db plus the Brain mini console web UI (http://127.0.0.1:8767).
reminder_message: ✦ brain navigates the user's memory: brain_overview (stats), brain_graph / brain_local (constellation + neighborhoods), brain_node (full chunk detail w/ provenance, backlinks, conflicts), brain_search (fast FTS typeahead), brain_entities, brain_conflicts, brain_timeline, open_brain_console (interactive web UI). All tools are READ-ONLY over memory.db. For ranked semantic recall keep using Vodou-Recall search_memory; for writes use memory_store / mem CLI.

notes.database: Opens <root>/memory.db strictly read-only via node:sqlite (VODOU_MEMORY_DB overrides). Never writes; safe to call freely.
notes.web_ui: open_brain_console spawns dist/serve.js on 127.0.0.1:8767 (BRAIN_PORT overrides) — GET-only JSON API + static UI, Host-header guarded, localhost bind.
notes.relationship_to_vodou_recall: Complementary, not overlapping: Vodou-Recall = ranked recall + writes; brain = structure/navigation (graph, provenance, conflicts, timeline).
